title: KasirAI
summary: Concept for an AI-powered point-of-sale system for Indonesian small businesses, aimed at easier inventory tracking and sales insights. Academic team project; not yet built.
summaryId: Konsep sistem kasir (point-of-sale) berbasis AI untuk UMKM Indonesia, bertujuan mempermudah pencatatan stok dan wawasan penjualan. Proyek tim akademik; belum dibangun.
